steps.code:
# Let's parse the content of the file to extract the list of song titles and artists.
# The format appears to be "- <Song Title> by <Artist(s)>" per line, with a header line at the top.

import re

file_content = old_songs_file["content"]
lines = file_content.splitlines()
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("- "):
        # Remove "- " and split by " by "
        match = re.match(r"- (.+) by (.+)", line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists = [artist.strip() for artist in match.group(2).split(",")]
            old_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})

print(old_songs)  # List of dicts with title and artists for each song to archive.
